meta.title: Event reasoning — TitleDetailsView (early instance)
meta.description:
## Event → field reasoning — TitleDetailsView

- **BookTitleAdded** → sets all fields (titleId, title, author, isbn, genre, publicationYear, coverImageUrl) — the only source this early instance can use.

**Deliberate simplification**: this instance intentionally does NOT include BookTitleDetailsUpdated, because its consumers (AddCopy and Edit-Details screens) sit before any edit could have happened on this timeline's representative column layout. A second instance further right (see the note near the Archive screen) adds BookTitleDetailsUpdated once it is causally available.
